correctness.rationale: The Euler-trail characterization gives necessary/sufficient feasibility. Disjoint support-size strata and unique endpoint imbalance make the full rational enumeration exhaustive, with disconnected 3-vertex cross-arc patterns subtracted before loop insertion. All six directed endpoints are disjoint; rational simplification and pole orders yield the stated formula and exact period. Independently generated word profiles agree for n=1..11 and matrix criterion enumeration for edge totals 0..12. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite result. All boundary and labeling assumptions are explicit.

value.rationale: A complete natural invariant of unordered 2-gram reconstruction for a labeled three-symbol source is determined at every length, including its exact noiseless maximum codebook size and six-period finite-size fluctuations. The exact three-symbol endpoint and support-connectivity effects go beyond earlier binary/cyclic formulas and asymptotic leading order. The coefficient 7/8640 is explicitly recognized as already implied by earlier Markov-type asymptotics. No unsupported efficient construction, alphabet-general theorem, or error-correction benefit is claimed.
